answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 43435 Country: India Title: Dream Question: My mother often sees big white-coloured fishes in her dreams. Last week, she saw 3 big white-coloured fishes which were brought to our home by a fish selling woman. Also, I saw two white-coloured big birds in two different rooms in our house. Please let me know what do these dreams indicate? Answer ID: 43435 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 212/212/M=1434) Both the dreams are good. In-shaAllah, your home shall abound in blessings and virtues. Offer salah regularly. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
